about_the_game:
Fungi Fantastico Demo is a colorful first-person platforming adventure set in a vibrant, mushroom-filled world. Play as a druidic nature-magic staff wielder who must combat a toxic fungal infestation spreading through your peaceful valley.

What’s Included in the Demo?

  • Tutorial Level – Learn the core mechanics, including movement, jumping, and using your nature beam to interact with mushrooms.

  • First Level – Explore the opening area of the game, where you’ll start to uncover the fungal corruption and gain your first movement-enhancing abilities.

  • Core Mechanics Preview – Experience the fundamental gameplay, including popping mushrooms for buffs, double jumping, dashing, and early gravity control mechanics.

This demo offers a glimpse into the world of Fungi Fantastico, showcasing its unique traversal system and nature-based abilities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 17-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible Sound Card
